scope.policy_owner: this separate work_delegation_gate task queue; optimizer fallback preserves ownership only while physical gate is inactive
scope.authoritative_boundary: O USER_INPUT_INBOX revision 24 forbids applying the old revision-23 least-Work policy to primary O
scope.allowed_work: One gate-owned bounded mechanical support task per invocation, directly executed by the physical gate when active or by automation_optimizer fallback when the physical gate is inactive and managed capacity is saturated.
prohibited: append or reassert least-Work into O USER_INPUT_INBOX
mutate primary O WORK_STRATEGY or WORK_EXECUTION_STATE
interrupt or replace a valid primary-O frozen Work execution
act as a second O writer
write clean exploration namespaces, downstream semantic outputs or other-role receipts

last_execution.result: Current reproducibility_auditor config2 execution is proven by a bootstrap-valid durable receipt and downstream-eligible MindMemOS artifact; latest subject adds nonduplicate implementation/reproduction evidence.

routing_policy.empty_queue_behavior: derive one bounded optimizer maintenance task or execute one non-duplicative gate-local integrity sweep; never switch to logical no-op
routing_policy.optimizer_fallback: execute at most one gate-owned mechanical task only while physical gate is inactive and managed physical slots are saturated; preserve idempotency/CAS/write isolation and stop if gate becomes physically active

rollback.condition: Restore the prior queue/state only if the onboarding completion was based on a non-current or bootstrap-invalid receipt, or if fallback violated gate-local write isolation/idempotency. Do not export least-Work routing into primary O.

next_action: On the next optimizer/gate invocation, re-resolve current control and physical gate status, then execute the remaining integrator-invalid-triplet quarantine validation if still pending.
